subject: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates & model roster
messages:
From: Marc Tan <marc.tan@aurhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: per-1M token rates + model lineup for hosted API

Hi Evelyn,

Quick one — we’re doing an evaluation of hosted LLM providers and I wanted a concise baseline we can share internally. Can you send your standard per-1M token rates (input / output split) for the hosted API and a brief list of supported model families (and any model-specific IO rates if you have them)?

A few context points:
- Primary use: clinical notes summarization and structured extraction (batch + some real-time endpoints)
- Rough starting volume: 2-4M tokens / month; could scale quickly if production looks good
- Compliance: SOC2 + HIPAA posture matters; we may ask about a private deployment down the road

Also curious if you have a simple discount/commitment matrix (e.g., 0-1M / 1-5M / 5M+) and any minimum term for discounted rates. If you prefer, send a ballpark now and we can schedule a quick call.

Thanks,
Marc
Marc Tan
Head of Platform, Aureus Health
marc.tan@aurhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marc Tan <marc.tan@aurhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per-1M token rates + model lineup for hosted API

Hi Marc 9,

Thanks for the context — appreciate the clarity. High-level baseline for our hosted API (all numbers per 1M tokens):

- Small-family (latency-optimized): Input $6 / Output $8
- Medium-family (balanced): Input $9 / Output $11
- Large-family (high-capacity, higher quality): Input $16 / Output $20
- Embeddings (per-1M text units): $12

Notes: 
- Input vs output rates are priced separately (input = tokens sent in requests, output = tokens returned).
- Model-family names correspond to our catalog; specific model variants within a family may carry +/- 10-20% adjustments depending on compute profile.

I attached our Q2 ratecard and a short file with model catalog links so you can see exact model names and recommended use cases. For discounts, we generally provide tiered volume pricing: 1-5M and 5M+ often require a 3-6 month commit for a stepped discount; we can be flexible for pilots. Dedicated / Private options are priced differently (larger commit, SLA).

Could you share an expected steady-state monthly token range (or a best guess)? If you want a formal quote or a provisional offer for ~3M tokens / month, Ben here can put together one. Also flagging Michael for security / compliance Qs if we need to follow up on SOC2 / HIPAA documentation.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
(Attach: redwood-hosted-ratecard-q2-2027.pdf, model-catalog-links.txt)
From: Marc Tan <marc.tan@aurhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per-1M token rates + model lineup for hosted API

Thanks Evelyn 9. Couple quick follow-ups: 

1) For a 3M tokens / month profile (mostly generation with ~60% output / 40% input split), what would a sample bill look like using the Medium-family? Just want to show finance a simple pro forma.
2) Do you apply the same discount tiers to the IO split (e.g., does the discount apply proportionally across input & output unit rates)?
3) What minimum term do you usually require for a 1-5M tier discount?

Also: is there a short SLA doc we can see for hosted? We care about latency percentiles and error handling (fallbacks to smaller models, etc.).

If it helps we can jump on a 30m call next week.

-Marc
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marc Tan <marc.tan@aurhealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per-1M token rates + model lineup for hosted API

Marc 9,

Appreciate the details — I put together a quick provisional offer attached so you have something to show finance. Highlights for Medium-family @ 3M tokens / month (assumes 60% output / 40% input):

- List price (Medium): Input $9k / 1M, Output $11k / 1M
- Monthly usage (3M): Input tokens = 1.2M => $10.8k; Output tokens = 1.8M => $19.8k; Total list = $30.6k
- Pilot discount: we can offer a 10% on list for the first 3 months without a long-term commit to help you evaluate (no minimum term).
- If you want a sustained 10% discount beyond pilot, we typically request a 3-month minimum commit at that tier; deeper discounts (15-25%) come with 6-12 month commitments or 12M+ annualized volume.

Discounts apply proportionally to input and output unit rates (we discount list price).

SLA: hosted API SLA details are summarized in our standard SLA doc attached in the offer and linked here: https://redwood.ai/sla-hosted. Latency SLOs depend on model family and region; we publish p50/p95 numbers on the console and can include sample latency traces for the Medium-family in us-west.

I attached a provisional offer PDF (non-binding) and a DocuSign link if you want to fast-track a pilot. Happy to schedule a technical call to discuss latency and security with Michael.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
(Attach: provisional-offer-AUREUS-3M.pdf)
